knobs.name: camera_kept_absent
knobs.mechanism: argument `state` of the second sysTester.BENCH_LINE(CAMERA, ON) is rewritten to OFF: the camera stays unavailable for the capture that must succeed

knobs.name: capture_dropped
knobs.mechanism: command productManager.CAPTURE is rewritten to cmdDisp.CMD_NO_OP: no picture is acquired where the test expects one

knobs.name: corrupt_picture

L2-2: picture record of P2 is JFIF, SOI to EOI, 640 x 480

knobs.mechanism: sysTester.CORRUPT_PRODUCT(name) is inserted before the second productManager.DOWNLINK: the first two bytes of the picture record of the stored product are overwritten on board; the test removes its products at teardown

knobs.name: no_restart
knobs.mechanism: the harness expects two process starts in the window where the procedure makes one
